targets.query:
-- NOTE: to add binance here i must concat and one tables to 2 subqueries
SELECT
  t1.ts_bucket,
  CONCAT(t1.ex, '-', t1.s, '-vs-', t2.s) t,
  sum((t1.p_bid - t2.p_bid - (t1.fair_premium * t2.p_bid)) / t2.p_bid * 100) spread_rel
FROM (
  WITH 10.95 * 0.01 AS risk_free_rate  -- riskFreeRateConst * riskFreerateMlt
  SELECT
    s,
    ex,
    regexpExtract(s, '^([A-Z]+?)(?:USDT-|-)') token_1,
    toFloat64OrZero(JSON_VALUE(obj_raw, '$.bid1Price')) p_bid,
    (toDateTime(toUInt64OrZero(JSON_VALUE(obj_raw, '$.deliveryTime')) / 1000) - now()) / (365*24*60*60) * risk_free_rate fair_premium,
    toStartOfHour(ts_write) ts_bucket,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s, ts_bucket ORDER BY ts_write DESC) as rank_last_event
  FROM default.tickers
  WHERE ex = 'bybit'
    AND k = 'fut'
    AND s like '%-%'
    AND p_bid != 0
    AND ts_write BETWEEN toDateTime($from) AND toDateTime($to)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    s,
    ex,
    conv_symbol_to_token_v2(ex, s) token_1,
    toFloat64(JSON_VALUE(obj_raw, '$.bidPrice')) p_bid,
    (parseDateTime(regexpExtract(s, '_(\d*)$'), '%y%m%d') - NOW()) / (365*24*60*60) * risk_free_rate fair_premium,
    toStartOfHour(ts_write) ts_bucket,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s, ts_bucket ORDER BY ts_write DESC) as rank_last_event
  FROM default.tickers
  WHERE ex = 'binance'
    AND k = 'fut'
    AND s LIKE '%\_%'
    AND ts_write BETWEEN toDateTime($from) AND toDateTime($to)
) t1
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    t1.s s,
    t1.ex ex,
    t2.base_coin token_1,
    p_bid,
    toStartOfHour(ts_write) ts_bucket,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s, ts_bucket ORDER BY ts_write DESC) as rank_last_event
  FROM (
    SELECT s, ex, k, ts_write, toFloat64OrZero(JSON_VALUE(obj_raw, '$.bid1Price')) p_bid
    FROM default.tickers
    WHERE ex = 'bybit'
      AND k = 'fut'
      AND s NOT LIKE '%-%'
      AND p_bid != 0
      AND ts_write BETWEEN toDateTime($from) AND toDateTime($to)
  ) t1
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT s, k, base_coin
    FROM default.bybit_instruments_info
    WHERE quote_coin in ('USDE', 'USDT', 'USDC')
  ) t2
    ON t1.s = t2.s AND t1.k = t2.k
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    s,
    ex,
    conv_symbol_to_token_v2(ex, s) token_1,
    toFloat64(JSON_VALUE(obj_raw, '$.bidPrice')) p_bid,
    toStartOfHour(ts_write) ts_bucket,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s, ts_bucket ORDER BY ts_write DESC) as rank_last_event
  FROM default.tickers
  WHERE ex = 'binance'
    AND k = 'fut'
    AND s NOT LIKE '%\_%'
    AND ts_write BETWEEN toDateTime($from) AND toDateTime($to)
) t2
  ON t1.token_1 = t2.token_1
    AND t1.ts_bucket = t2.ts_bucket
    AND t1.ex = t2.ex
WHERE t1.rank_last_event = 1
  AND t2.rank_last_event = 1
GROUP BY t, ts_bucket
ORDER BY t, ts_bucket DESC

targets.query:
SELECT
    ex,
    ccid,
    truncate((p_bid_fut - p_ask_spot) / p_ask_spot * 100, 2) diff_rel,
    sum(if(k = 'fut', p_bid_per_1_token, 0)) p_bid_fut,
    sum(if(k = 'spot', p_ask_per_1_token, 0)) p_ask_spot,
    groupArrayIf(ts_write, k = 'fut') ts_write_fut,
    groupArrayIf(ts_write, k = 'spot') ts_write_spot,
    groupArrayIf(s, k = 'fut') s_fut,
    groupArrayIf(s, k = 'spot') s_spot,
    groupArrayIf(p_bid, k = 'fut') p_bid_fut_raw,
    groupArrayIf(p_bid, k = 'spot') p_bid_spot_raw,
    groupArrayIf(ex, k = 'fut') ex_fut,
    groupArrayIf(ex, k = 'spot') ex_spot
FROM (
    SELECT
        t1.ex ex,
        t1.s s,
        t1.k k,
        t1.ts_write ts_write,
        if(t1.k = 'fut', replaceRegexpOne(t2.base_coin, '^(100*)', ''), t2.base_coin) token_1,
        t3.ccid,
        p_bid,
        p_ask,
        multiIf(
            (ex, k, s) = ('bybit', 'fut', 'SHIB1000PERP'), p_bid / pow(10, 3),
            (ex, k, s) = ('bybit', 'fut', 'SHIB1000USDT'), p_bid / pow(10, 3),
            k = 'fut', p_bid / pow(10, LENGTH(regexpExtract(t2.base_coin, '^1(0*)'))),
            p_bid
        ) p_bid_per_1_token,
        multiIf(
            (ex, k, s) = ('bybit', 'fut', 'SHIB1000PERP'), p_ask / pow(10, 3),
            (ex, k, s) = ('bybit', 'fut', 'SHIB1000USDT'), p_ask / pow(10, 3),
            k = 'fut', p_ask / pow(10, LENGTH(regexpExtract(t2.base_coin, '^1(0*)'))),
            p_ask
        ) p_ask_per_1_token,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ex, k, ccid ORDER BY ts_write DESC) as rank_last_event
    FROM (
        SELECT
            ex,
            s,
            k,
            ts_write,
            toFloat64(JSON_VALUE(obj_raw, '$.bid1Price')) p_bid,
            toFloat64OrZero(JSON_VALUE(obj_raw, '$.ask1Price')) p_ask
        FROM default.tickers
        WHERE ex = 'bybit'
            AND s NOT LIKE '%-%'
            AND ts_write >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
    ) t1
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT s, k, base_coin
        FROM default.bybit_instruments_info
        WHERE quote_coin in ('USDE', 'USDT', 'USDC')
    ) t2
        ON t1.s = t2.s AND t1.k = t2.k
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *
        FROM default.ex_k_to_ccid
        WHERE ex = 'bybit'
    ) t3
        ON token_1 = t3.base AND t1.k = t3.k
    WHERE t2.base_coin != '' AND t3.ccid != ''
)
WHERE rank_last_event = 1
GROUP BY ex, ccid
HAVING p_bid_fut != 0 AND p_ask_spot != 0
ORDER BY abs(diff_rel) DESC
LIMIT 20

        if(t1.k = 'fut', replaceRegexpOne(t2.base_coin, '^(100*)', ''), t2.base_coin) token_1,

targets.query:
SELECT
    t1.token_1,
    t1.s s_fut_exp,
    t2.s s_fut_perp,
    truncate((p_fut_exp - p_fut_perp) / p_fut_perp * 100, 4) diff_rel,
    t1.p_bid p_fut_exp,
    t2.p_bid p_fut_perp,
    t1.fair_premium * p_fut_perp spread_fair,
    -- NOTE: source formulas are here https://ru.tradingview.com/v/9HzSne1K/
    (p_fut_exp - p_fut_perp - spread_fair) / p_fut_perp * 100 spread_rel
FROM (
    WITH 10.95 * 0.01 AS risk_free_rate  -- riskFreeRateConst * riskFreerateMlt
    SELECT
        s,
        regexpExtract(s, '^([A-Z]+?)(?:USDT-|-)') token_1,
        toFloat64OrZero(JSON_VALUE(obj_raw, '$.bid1Price')) p_bid,
        (toDateTime(toUInt64OrZero(JSON_VALUE(obj_raw, '$.deliveryTime')) / 1000) - now()) / (365*24*60*60) * risk_free_rate fair_premium,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY token_1, s ORDER BY ts_write DESC) as rank_last_event
    FROM default.tickers
    WHERE ex = 'bybit' AND k = 'fut' AND s like '%-%' AND p_bid != 0
        AND ts_write >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
) t1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        t1.s s,
        t2.base_coin token_1,
        p_bid,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY token_1, s ORDER BY ts_write DESC) as rank_last_event
    FROM (
        SELECT s, k, ts_write, toFloat64OrZero(JSON_VALUE(obj_raw, '$.bid1Price')) p_bid
        FROM default.tickers
        WHERE ex = 'bybit' AND k = 'fut' AND s not like '%-%' AND p_bid != 0
            AND ts_write >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
    ) t1
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT s, k, base_coin
        FROM default.bybit_instruments_info
        WHERE quote_coin in ('USDE', 'USDT', 'USDC')
    ) t2
        ON t1.s = t2.s AND t1.k = t2.k
) t2
    ON t1.token_1 = t2.token_1
WHERE t1.rank_last_event = 1 AND t2.rank_last_event = 1
ORDER BY abs(diff_rel) DESC
